body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: a23ba3c657bcbcad794b6c0bf1a68d6938e200f7 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The review covers the trial merge with upstream/main at dab6498aed0ab078a97f0892c417d161135219fa. All builds and tests ran locally in an isolated worktree. No GitHub runner was used.

The fixture now runs the verify gate across all six Z-bands. It checks the gouge result and the shank collision that blocks posting. The geometry tests cover shallow edges, overhangs, and convex raster chords. No golden files changed. No UI files changed.

Validation results:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: two steps passed. Motion: 529 passed, 42 ignored. App: 255 passed, 14 ignored. This includes all 33 golden CL tests.
- `cargo test --release -p camcraft-motion --test finish3d_overhang_and_chord`: 3 passed.
- `cargo test --release -p camcraft-app --test shared_face_bodies_finish -- --include-ignored`: 8 passed, including all six bands.
- `cargo test --release -p camcraft-motion --test finish3d -- --include-ignored`: 88 passed.
- `cargo test --release -p camcraft-motion --test swarf_pose_continuity`: 6 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed with no warnings.

Safety mutations:
- Disabled ring column trimming. The overhang test failed at Waterline move 17: distance 2.6701 mm was below 2.9900 mm.
- Removed the raster chord cap. The convex-cylinder test failed with four gouge cells and a maximum gouge of 0.011113 mm.
- Restored both changes. All three safety regression tests passed again.

Requested changes: none.

Nonblocking note: `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/rings.rs` grew to 536 lines. A later split can keep this file near the project size guideline.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
